messages:
sarah.docs: quick heads-up — i opened a PR to fix the api-ref for the `generate` endpoint. examples show `input: string` but the runtime now accepts `inputs: string[]` and the example payloads are inconsistent with the JS snippet. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/912

ali.eng: thanks — do you have the buggy curl + corrected curl so i can run a quick test against staging?

sarah.docs: yup — pasted both below. the broken one (what's currently on the site):
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $KEY' \n  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \n  -d '{"model": "redwood/gpt-3x", "input": "Summarize this...", "max_new_tokens": 64}'\n```

and the intended example (matches runtime and SDK):
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $KEY' \n  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \n  -d '{"model_id": "redwood/gpt-3x", "inputs": ["Summarize this..."], "max_new_tokens": 64}'\n```

mike.sdk: noted — our JS snippet was also using `model` + `input`. SDK already maps `inputs` <-> `input` for backwards compat but the docs should show canonical `inputs` array. i'll update the client snippet in sdk PR 438 to demonstrate `inputs: ["..."]` and include a one-line compatibility note.

olivia.prod: can we add a short migration blurb in the api-ref top section: "If you previously passed `input` (string), switch to `inputs` (array). SDKs accept both for now, but this will be standardized." also add a note about `model_id` vs `model` param name change. that's important for customers who search examples.

ali.eng: i ran the corrected curl against staging — works, returns an array of outputs in `choices` (was erroring before). i'll paste the response sample and add it to the PR as the approved response example.

sarah.docs: awesome — i'll push one more tiny change: update the JSON schema snippet in the OpenAPI example to show `inputs: string[]` and add the migration note. also adding a JS sample using the SDK client with `await client.generate({ model_id: 'redwood/gpt-3x', inputs: ['...'] })`.

docs-bot: Link-checker: docs/publish failed — broken internal link to /sdk/js/examples in docs/pull/912.

mike.sdk: i'll fix the example link in the SDK readme and open sdk PR 439 to update deployable snippets.

sarah.docs: cool — who's comfortable merging once link-check passes? i'd like to land before tomorrow's release cut.

ali.eng: i can merge after my quick smoke test and once the docs CI passes. ping me here after the bot is green.

olivia.prod: thanks all — will add this to release notes under "API reference fixes" so CS can proactively reach out if customers hit the old examples. :thumbsup:

sarah.docs: thanks everyone — tracking: docs PR 912 (fix examples + schema), sdk PR 438 (snippet change), sdk PR 439 (link fix), follow-up internal migration note. i'll update the PR description with the staging response sample and expected behavior.
